name: Summit AZ - Blog What Not to Put Down a Garbage Disposal 2026-09-10
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

# Summary
SEO-ready draft of "What Not to Put Down Your Garbage Disposal (A Plumber's Honest List)". The Sep 10 work report confirms it was rewritten, published and indexed at `/blog/what-not-to-put-in-garbage-disposal/`, with a banner image and a link from the clogged drains post.

# Rank Math settings
- Focus keyword: "what not to put down a garbage disposal". Secondaries: garbage disposal not working, jammed, humming, kitchen drain clog.
- Title: "What Not to Put Down a Garbage Disposal: A Plumber's List" (58 characters). Meta 143 characters. Category: Drains & Sewers.

# Key decision
- The original keyword "garbage disposal repair Mesa" was the focus keyword of the commercial page `/garbage-disposal-service-mesa/`, so the blog was moved to the informational query and links to that service page instead of competing with it. "drain cleaning Mesa AZ" was dropped from the secondaries for the same reason.

# Content
- Short answer first, then the list: grease and oil, coffee grounds, pasta and rice, eggshells, fibrous vegetables, potato peels, pits and bones, non-food items, each with what happens in the pipe.
- Links to existing posts such as how to prevent clogged drains.
